analysis_unlock_condition: 40 eligible accepted complete sessions / 960 accepted ballots after outcome-blind reconciliation of the frozen distribution log and prospective exclusions, then the unchanged frozen B8 accepted-session rule
authorized_distribution_scope: exactly one frozen pkgv9slot URL to each eligible voter slot 1..40
collection_transport_preservation_rule: Any index.html deploy during collection must preserve the exact B9 transport block SHA256 9750dc02cdc3b65874a48211d3e7c86c5f6bd9b401855775254ef0c3cc0d5dca.

deployment.source_exactness_basis: GitHub workflow-dispatch operator attestation linking frozen V4 bytes to web-app version 3, corroborated by exact frozen source SHA and live structural behavior; Apps Script source is not machine-readable back from the deployment

eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.b8_accepted_session_rule_unchanged: After prospective eligibility exclusions, choose the complete valid session with the earliest frozen B8 final-vote timestamp; exact ties use lexicographically smallest session_id.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.basis: Prospective, outcome-blind clarification of the frozen B8 voter-eligibility rule, frozen before any real V9 vote exists.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.distribution_log: research/package-adjustment-v9/b10d-p6-final-launch-checklist/distribution_log.csv with columns slot,utc_sent,recipient_pseudonym_sha256,is_replacement; every initial send and replacement issuance is logged at the time of sending, and the log is committed on main before any outcome analysis.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.launchtest_named_exclusions: All rows with challenge id pkgv9val_LAUNCHTEST and/or session envelope slot 0 are excluded, including every B10A/B10B sentinel session.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.monitor_maturity_caveat: The P5 monitor is structural only and does not read the distribution log. A structural 40/40 signal does not by itself unlock outcomes if any pre-distribution or duplicate-recipient exclusion applies; the locked analysis stage must reconcile the distribution log outcome-blind before computing or exposing choices.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.one_slot_per_person: A recipient pseudonym hash may appear for only one slot; if it appears for more than one, sessions in the later-issued slot are excluded and the event is recorded as a protocol deviation.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.pre_distribution_exclusion: A V9 session is ineligible if its earliest server timestamp precedes the recorded distribution time of its slot (or of the replacement issuance governing that session). Ineligible sessions are excluded and recorded before the frozen B8 accepted-session rule is applied.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.recipient_pseudonym_rule: recipient_pseudonym_sha256 = SHA256(UTF-8(lowercase(trim(stable recipient handle)) + newline + private offline study salt)); use the same private salt for all recipients and never commit the salt or raw handles.
eligibility_clarifications_frozen_before.server_timestamp_authority: Distribution-window rules use the doPost server timestamp (private sheet column A), never the client vote timestamp. The B8 accepted-session ordering rule is unchanged among sessions that remain eligible after these prospective exclusions.

next_if_pass: Distribute only the frozen slot URL template. Maintain the committed per-slot distribution log for every initial/replacement issuance and enforce one person per slot. Monitor only via the frozen v9_structural_status endpoint. Do not inspect human choices or run outcome analysis until an outcome-blind distribution-log reconciliation confirms 40 eligible accepted complete sessions / 960 accepted ballots.
owner_no_peek_commitment_text: Do not open the private V9 validation sheet or inspect choice-bearing Apps Script execution payloads during collection; use only the frozen outcome-blind structural monitor. A structural 40/40 signal does not itself authorize outcome inspection; first complete the frozen outcome-blind distribution-log eligibility reconciliation and confirm 40 eligible accepted complete sessions / 960 accepted ballots.
